'''Urtagh''' was the name given to a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was infected by the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] during the [[rakghoul pandemic]] and grew to a massive size. The beast was [[Death/Legends|slain]] in the [[Outlaw's Den]] region.

==Behind the scenes==
Urtagh appeared as a World Boss for the Rakghoul Pandemic World Event in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which occurred in early [[2011]] and has since not been repeated.
